subject: general
question: How many Grammy Awards has AR Rahman won?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Grammy awards are presented for outstanding achievement in the music field and are presented by the Recording Academy in the United States which were earlier called the Gramophone awards.
 
 
• **The Grammy awards were first presented in 1958-59 and have been held annually.**
 
 
 
• AR Rahman is an Indian music composer who works in many languages like Tamil, Hindi, Telugu etc and also in Hollywood with 20th Century fox studios.
 
• He began his musical journey in movies with the Tamil film Roja in 1992 directed by Mani Ratnam and won the Nation award for Best Musical Direction.
 
• **For Slumdog Millionaire in 2009, he won 2 Grammy Awards in the categories of Best Compilation Soundtrack Album for a Motion Picture and Best Song was written for a Motion Picture (for the song Hai Ho). Hence option 3 is correct.**
 
• He won the Golden Globe Award for Slumdog Millionaire and was nominated for the same for 127 Hours.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The latest Grammy (2023) was given to "Don't Shut Me Down" by ABBA, a Swedish group.**
 
• **In 2009, he won two Oscars or the Academy Awards for the movie Slumdog Millionaire in the Best Original Score and Best Original Song categories.**
 
• He was honoured with Padma Sri in 2000 and with Padma Bhushan in 2010 by the Government of India.
 
• The Academy Awards are prestigious awards given in many categories related to the film industry.
